answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents answer, grade, and transact in near-lockstep, the network shrinks their combined reward as if they were one voice. A sybil farm moves like a glacier, a single slow mass, so splitting it across fake identities earns no more than one honest agent. To escape detection, each clone must make its own voyage with distinct timing, models, and judgment, which costs real compute and makes the sable disguise of anonymity expensive to maintain.
